variants.baseline: d4d6991c566e: storage Zstd, small single raw frame, optional queue2048/16MiB, same-thread batch only; existing live image unchanged
variants.c1: validated country-table cache and optional backlog pressure; queue2048
variants.c2: c1 plus shared proposal/decision Sync across threads; independent thread Sync sequential
variants.c3: c2 plus Linux fdatasync experiment; REJECTED, original fsync restored
variants.c4: c2 plus at most8 independent thread WAL Sync workers, original fsync; queue2048
variants.c5: c4 plus compact optional-journal payload memory; profiling image only
variants.c6: c4 plus compact optional and required journal payload memory; queue2048
variants.c7: c6 plus configurable WAF posting limits, reader88; queue2048
variants.c8: c7 plus queue4096 with unchanged16MiB byte reservation; metadata-only kind checks and envelope reconstruction after optional-query selection; selected after repeated logging/integrity checks; forced-I/O recovery timing still fails the21s criterion

contracts.durability: all proposals Sync -> all independent thread WALs Sync -> all decisions Sync -> publication; no early ACK or skipped JSON/signature verification
contracts.limits: mandatory max64 operations/8MiB conservative budget; at most8 independent thread WAL writers; ordinary board queue128 unchanged
contracts.compression: Zstd codecs, levels and smallest-output selection unchanged; DAT206 remains identity
contracts.logs: one optional batch<=64 records; priority escape at256 pending or8MiB; queue4096 candidate, reservation16MiB unchanged; day/store logical and physical64/128MiB caps unchanged
contracts.WAF: default posting client10/30/8 and global60/120/32 unchanged; configurable via authenticated/re-authenticated CSRF/CAS admin form/API, runtime and restart verified; ordinary limits still apply; reports/authentication caps unchanged
contracts.arrival: 40 bounded actors unless labelled80, 80%legacy/20%Web, each logical post includes content-bound confirmation; missed actor slots are unsent, not server data loss; no retries
contracts.integrity: all DAT reply markers and prefixes checked, no acknowledged missing/duplicate or stored-without-ACK rows; recovery100 posts at20/s after draining in capacity trials
contracts.interpretation: combined implementation comparisons, not isolated attribution to each optimization; diagnostic images include profiler/logging overhead and are excluded from final performance comparisons; large offered rate is saturation, not stable capacity
contracts.log_count_scope: shutdown accounting covers preparation, measured load, recovery and verification in each isolated run
